versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

- Simplified credential management: API key now read only from an api_key file located in the same directory as the SKILL.md file, not from other local paths or environment variables.
- Added clear instructions for creating and securely handling the skill-local api_key file, with confirmation required before storing keys.
- Updated the workflow to always include sourceType=5 as an integration routing parameter, and specify when to include it in request details.
- Removed external script and skill card files and added .clawhubignore for better project structure.
- Expanded confirmation requirements before uploading, overwriting, deleting, decrypting, or protecting documents.

- Added a requirement to include the internal routing parameter sourceType in every ComPDF API request (hidden from user-facing text and logs).
- Updated the workflow to ensure that this new routing parameter is handled correctly.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to supported operations or skill description.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated the API key instructions URL to use "clawhub" in the referral parameters for better attribution.
- No changes to supported features or workflow.

Initial release of compdf-documents-to-pdf.

- Converts Word, Excel, PPT, HTML, TXT, CSV, RTF, PNG, and JPG files to PDF.
- Supports selection and use of official ComPDF Server API endpoints with accurate request planning.
- Details step-by-step workflow for operation selection, API key management, and safe document handling.
- Guides on producing only PDF output (no PDF editing or reverse conversion).
- Provides instructions for obtaining and storing the required API key securely.
